## Tutorials

The DateValue() function returns a date based on a string.

Note:If the given string does not include a year component, this function will use the current year.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT DateValue("May 17, 2017");

---

DateValue(
string_date
)

---

SELECT DateValue("May 17");
```

## Tutorials

The Day() function returns the day of the month for a given date.

This function returns an integer between 1 and 31.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Day(#05/17/2017#);

---

Day(
date
)

---

SELECT Day(Date());

---

SELECT Day(BirthDate) FROM Employees;
```

## Tutorials

The Format() function formats a date value with the specified format.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Format(BirthDate, "Long Date") AS FormattedBirthDate
FROM Employees;

---

Format(
value
,
format
,
firstdayofweek
,
firstweekofyear
)
```

## Tutorials

The Hour() function returns the hour part of a time/datetime.

This function returns an integer between 0 and 23.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 
  Hour(#14:48:23#);

---

Hour(
time
)

---

SELECT 
  Hour(Now());

---

SELECT Hour(#24/10/2016 11:18:34 PM#);
```

## Tutorials

The Minute() function returns the minute part of a time/datetime.

This function returns an integer between 0 and 59.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 
  Minute(#14:48:23#);

---

Minute(
time
)

---

SELECT 
  Minute(Now());

---

SELECT 
  Minute(#24/10/2016 11:18:34 PM#);
```
